verses.1: Who will believe our words? And who will listen to the words of Jehovah? Who will be revealed?
verses.2: And he stood before him. From the land of Ziha, no one could see him; neither day nor night. They tried to see him, but they couldn’t. They also tried to worship him.
verses.3: I was terrified and stopped in my tracks. One person suffered greatly from pain, and I knew about his condition. But I kept my feelings hidden from him. I remained silent.
verses.4: Now, our suffering is carried along with us; our pain also accompanies us. We consider it to be a punishment from God.
verses.5: And he is a savior from our sins. He relieves us of our troubles. He heals us in his presence.
verses.6: We are all like sheep; each one goes his own way. May Jehovah destroy those who cause harm to us all.
verses.7: He rushed towards her, but she did not open her mouth. When it was time for eating, Yubal and Krael stood before her, but she still did not open her mouth.
verses.8: From captivity and from judgment, he was taken away. Who will take his life? For he was taken from the land of life because of my people’s sins.
verses.9: And he gave the wicked their graves, and the rich their deaths, because they did not do good deeds or commit any deceitful practices.
verses.10: And Jehovah will be pleased if you set your heart before Him. Then He will see that the seed will flourish for many days. And Jehovah will have His way in this matter.
verses.11: He who toils his soul will be honored in his knowledge. He will become a righteous servant for many people. And he will bring them peace.
verses.12: Therefore, he will divide them among many people. He will also divide their souls among those who have been redeemed from death. And the wicked will be punished. He will bear the sins of many people, and the wicked will be destroyed.
